units.source_text: 往后要是刮上一夜大风雪，你再来瞧瞧，恐怕你来不了了吧？

en.t: If a great snowstorm blows all night sometime from now on, come and take another look; I doubt you would be able to make it, would you?

units.source_text: 那种时候，野鸡和兔子都逃到人家家里哩。”

en.t: At times like that, pheasants and rabbits all flee into people's houses.

units.source_text: 驹子虽然这么说，然而声音却显得快活、响亮，也许是消防队员的吆喝声和人们的脚步声使她振奋吧。

en.t: Although Komako said this, her voice sounded cheerful and clear, perhaps lifted by the firefighters' shouts and the sound of people's footsteps.

units.source_text: 岛村也觉得浑身轻松了。

en.t: Shimamura, too, felt his whole body grow light.
